messages:
maya: Heads-up — CI failing on docs build for the last deploy, mkdocs log shows a KeyError during TOC generation.

maya: Full pipeline log: https://ci.redwood.example/teams/docs/1234

tom: I saw that too. My hunch: malformed list/spacing in one of the markdown files — Docusaurus TOC generator is pretty picky.

erica: Can you point to the file path and a sample snippet?

maya: pages/guides/deploying.md — found lines like:

```
- Step one.  
- Step two.  
  - substep
```

maya: Those trailing two spaces are markdown hardbreaks. In combination with a blank indented line the TOC slugifier produces an empty token and the link resolver crashes.

sam: Huh. I thought trailing spaces were harmless formatting. Didn't realize they could break TOC generation. :face_with_monocle:

tom: Quick fixes: remove trailing spaces or add explicit heading ids. Longer term: run a normalizer across docs or enable strict mkdocs build.

erica: I can open a small PR to strip trailing spaces and add a `mkdocs build --strict` check in CI.

maya: Enabling strict would catch these earlier, +1 from me.

docs-bot: @maya opened PR #2467 — "docs: strip trailing spaces in bulleted lists and enable mkdocs strict" — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2467

tom: Reviewing now. Small request: add a short changelog line about formatting-only changes.

erica: Done — added changelog note and a tiny test in .github/workflows/docs-ci.yml that runs `mkdocs build --strict`.

ci-bot: docs CI started for PR #2467 — running mkdocs build

ci-bot: docs CI ✅ build succeeded (mkdocs build --strict) — all checks passed

maya: Merging PR now into main; will trigger the docs deploy.

maya: Merged and deploy started — https://deploy.redwood.example/docs/3378

docs-bot: Deploy to staging succeeded :rocket: — https://staging.docs.redwood.example/guides/deploying.html

sam: Verified the previously broken TOC link is fixed on staging. Anchors look sane now.

erica: Thanks! I'll add a short note in CONTRIBUTING.md about avoiding hard trailing spaces in lists and recommend the normalizer.

tom: Suggestion: add the normalizer as a pre-commit hook so it runs locally before PRs. Could reduce spammy formatting fixes.

maya: Agreed — filed follow-up issue #102 to track pre-commit hook and broader linting.

maya: Closing thread, thanks everyone :heart:
